description: A real-time aircraft state update, broadcast via at.adsb.broadcast.subscribeEvents. Ephemeral — not written to a PDS.

main.description: Current state of a tracked aircraft as observed by a single receiver.

aircraft.description: Strong reference to the at.adsb.aircraft.identity record for this aircraft.

position.description: Most recent position fix for this aircraft.

nic.description: Navigation Integrity Category (0-11). Higher is more precise.

rc.description: Radius of containment in metres. Derived from NIC.

rssi.description: Received signal strength indicator in dBFS.

seen.description: Seconds since last message from this aircraft.

seenPos.description: Seconds since last position fix from this aircraft.

messageCount.description: Total messages received from this aircraft in the current tracking session.
